title: Area minimizing cycles in ℝ^P are stationary
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) that is minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ) with ∂C = 0 (BoundaryVanishes C), and every integer multiplicity triple R ∈ IMRep ℝ^P n representing C: R.firstVariation X = 0 for every C¹ vector field X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → R.Represents C → ∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → R.firstVariation X = 0
